original_criteria_do_not_require_this_un: The exact min/ceil functionals define the already chosen frozen family. No claim is made that the paper permits only this choice. An alternative sufficient original-compliant schedule would require an explicit separate construction, source rebinding and revalidation; it is not silently substituted here.
sufficient_bound_warning: S_pbar <= M implies P_hat <= pbar, but does not bound S_(P_hat) by M. A different sufficient C,P does not evaluate or preserve the frozen scale.

counterexample.scope: abstract selector distinction, not an actual source replacement

conditional_computable_routes: Prove finite S_hat_0 with a certified global upper bound: minimal P_hat is then exactly zero.
For p>0 prove finite S_hat_p and infinite S_hat_(p-1); Lambda>=1 covers all smaller p.
Once P_hat is identified, any rigorous interval [Slo,Shi] encloses C by [1+ceil(Slo),1+ceil(Shi)]; exact supremum equality is unnecessary for an enclosing L interval.
A ceiling interval crossing an integer may remain nontrivial; do not replace it by its midpoint or claim a selected exact integer.

scale_supremum_reparametrization.identity: sup_(a>=1,(x,t) in D) W*|T_a Z_j|_m = sup_((x,t) in D,q<=s<=1) W*|D^alpha T_a Z_j evaluated at a=s/q|_max
scale_supremum_reparametrization.derivative_order_rule: Differentiate with a CONSTANT, then substitute a=s/q; do not differentiate the substituted expression at fixed s.
scale_supremum_reparametrization.reason: For q>0, s=a*q is a bijection [1,infinity) to [q,infinity); all cutoff jets vanish on s>=1.
scale_supremum_reparametrization.remaining_noncompact_endpoint: q approaches zero; this still requires actual weighted source bounds and exponent minimality

original_criteria.title: 전역 에너지 balance
original_criteria.verbatim_original:
d(∥u∥²₂/2)/dt+ν∥∇u∥²₂=⟨f,u⟩를 전체 K에서 적분한다. core만의 에너지와 구분한다. 합격: 정규화 energy defect가
독립 space/time refinement에서 감소한다. ν=1에서 (10.13)의 ∥u(t)∥² ₂+2∫∥∇u∥²₂≤(∫∥f∥₂)² 상계와 모순 없어야
한다.
original_criteria.evaluation_target: The same actual whole localized velocity u and whole force f, integrated over the entire fixed compact support K. Core-only energy is distinct.
equations: At nu=1: ||u(t)||_2² + 2 integral_0^t ||grad u(s)||_2² ds <= (integral_0^t ||f(s)||_2 ds)²; paper (10.13).
measured_outputs: Normalized energy defect and all terms/normalization definition
Independent spatial-refinement comparison, with temporal choice held fixed
Independent temporal-refinement comparison, with spatial choice held fixed
Whole-support quadrature/truncation and error budgets sufficient to interpret decrease and no contradiction with (10.13)
original_criteria.scope_limit: Finite positive-tau windows and selected runs must be explicit. The analytical energy theorem alone is not the required numerical refinement comparison.
not_sufficient: A toy/model/zero extension standing in for the actual global fixture
Naming f as the full PDE residual without evaluating its actual terms and the energy/refinement quantities; defining f by that residual is itself the original construction
Assuming an analytic weighted-supremum selector is an effective numerical evaluator
original_criteria.numeric_threshold: N7-06 itself gives no fixed tau list, grid, tolerance, or factor-two requirement. It requires normalized defect decrease under independent space/time refinement. State actual chosen window, tau, quadrature, tails and error budget.

original_criteria.title: 공간·급수·정밀도 적응
original_criteria.verbatim_original:
core radius, axial length, pulse wavelength, active cutoff orders를 함께 해결한다. 각 refinement 축을 독립 증가시킨
다. 합격: 2배 grid, Fourier cutoff, coefficient order, arithmetic precision 비교표와 별도 tail bound를 저장한다. 예산
초과 시 last-resolved τ와 원인을 표시한다.
original_criteria.evaluation_target: Actual near-terminal construction with core radius, axial length, pulse wavelength and active cutoff orders resolved together.
measured_outputs: Baseline versus doubled spatial grid, holding other axes fixed
Baseline versus doubled Fourier cutoff, holding other axes fixed
Baseline versus doubled coefficient order, holding other axes fixed
Baseline versus doubled arithmetic precision, holding other axes fixed
Separate tail bounds for omitted contributions
On budget exceedance, last-resolved positive tau and the concrete cause
original_criteria.scope_limit: The four doubled-axis comparison table and tail record apply to the declared actual run/window; finite numerical evidence cannot be relabeled as an all-order or infinite-limit theorem.
not_sufficient: Doubling unused metadata or a parameter that cannot change the actual evaluator
Finite-stage structural equality or exact symbolic cutoff selection without evaluator outputs
Reusing periodic baseline solver tests as the whole-space paper construction
original_criteria.numeric_threshold: The factor two for grid/Fourier cutoff/coefficient order/arithmetic precision is explicit in N8-05. N8-04 separately lists tau=1e-2,1e-4,1e-8,1e-12; do not transplant that separate criterion as a new N8-05-only universal gate.
